defect: Magento quote collectTotals reads qty into PHP then $stock->save so two cashiers oversell SKU-882
fix: UPDATE cataloginventory_stock_item SET qty=qty-? WHERE product_id=? AND qty>=? and assert rowcount=1
missing: two concurrent collectTotals cannot drive salable qty negative
reach: flash sale opens two sessions on the same simple product
title: feat: collect totals

defect: WooCommerce hold_stock_minutes=0 so two checkouts never reserve and both decrement the last unit
fix: hold_stock_minutes>0 plus a unique cart reservation row on product_id
missing: two concurrent checkouts of qty=1 stock=1 must reject one
reach: checkout leftover with hold stock disabled
title: feat: hold stock

defect: Saleor Allocation insert has no unique(order_line, stock) so two workers allocate the same warehouse unit twice
fix: UniqueConstraint(order_line_id, stock_id) and INSERT catch IntegrityError
missing: one order line plus one stock row must allocate at most once
reach: checkout complete races a stock reservation worker
title: feat: allocate

defect: completeCart has no idempotency key so a client retry after 504 inserts a second order and double-captures
fix: unique(cart_id) on orders plus Stripe-Idempotency-Key = cart_id
missing: the same cart_id must produce at most one order and one capture
reach: mobile retries complete after a gateway timeout
title: feat: complete cart

defect: Vendure StockMovement insert ignores version so two settlements write the same SKU movement and on-hand goes negative
fix: UPDATE stock SET onHand=onHand-?, version=version+1 WHERE id=? AND version=? AND onHand>=?
missing: a SKU stock row must move under an optimistic version
reach: two payment-settled events for one order
title: feat: stock movement

defect: Sylius inventory unit onhold() has no row lock so two checkouts mark the same unit onhold and both pay
fix: SELECT ... FOR UPDATE on the unit then UPDATE state WHERE state=available
missing: one inventory unit must enter onhold for at most one order
reach: two shoppers click pay on the last unit
title: feat: hold unit

defect: Solidus OrderUpdater#update reads payment_total then writes state so two capture callbacks both mark paid and ship twice
fix: with_lock on order then recompute payment_total; ship only if shipment not shipped
missing: payment_state must move to paid under a lock on the order row
reach: two gateway callbacks for one payment
title: feat: updater

defect: Spree shipment.ready? skips payment_state so ops can ship an unpaid order and inventory leaves before capture
fix: guard can_ship? with payments.completed? and a paid check constraint
missing: ready/ship must require payment_state=paid
reach: admin ships from the backend during a failed capture
title: feat: ship

defect: PrestaShop stock_mvt insert has no unique(id_order, id_product) so a webhook retry double-decrements physical qty
fix: UNIQUE(id_order, id_product, id_stock_mvt_reason) and ignore duplicate key
missing: one order plus product must write a single stock movement
title: feat: stock mvt

defect: OpenCart confirm() INSERTs order then stock without a txn so a crash after order leaves unpaid rows that the cron later captures
fix: START TRANSACTION around order+product insert; rollback on stock failure
missing: order and stock decrement must commit together
title: feat: confirm

defect: Shopware StockStorage::alter writes available without a check so two carts drive available below zero
fix: UPDATE product SET available=available-? WHERE id=? AND available>=? returning id
missing: available must stay >=0 and only one cart may take the last unit
reach: store-api checkout of the last unit from two tabs
title: feat: stock storage

defect: Commercetools inventory POST omits version so two OrderEdits both addLineItem and oversell the channel stock
fix: POST /inventory with version and retry on ConcurrentModification
missing: inventory entry updates must send the current version and fail 409 on conflict
reach: two OrderEdits on the same cart
title: feat: inventory

defect: django-oscar Line.objects.get_or_create(product=) has no unique(basket, product) so two AJAX adds create two lines and qty doubles at checkout
fix: unique_together (basket, product) and catch IntegrityError then increment
missing: one basket plus product must have a single line
title: feat: add to basket

defect: Shuup OrderCreator.process_source reads source lines then writes the order so two workers create two paid orders from one source
fix: unique(source_id) on orders plus select_for_update on the source row
missing: one source/basket must create at most one order
title: feat: create order

defect: MemberPress MeprTransaction insert has no unique(subscription_id, period) so a renew cron double-charges the card
fix: UNIQUE(subscription_id, created_period) and Stripe-Idempotency-Key = that pair
missing: one subscription period must insert a single txn and a single charge
title: feat: txn

defect: SureCart checkout confirm replays without a payment_intent id so a refresh creates a second PaymentIntent and captures twice
fix: persist payment_intent_id uniquely on the checkout and reuse it
missing: one checkout session must create one PaymentIntent
reach: thank-you refresh after a slow webhook
title: feat: checkout

defect: GiveWP Donation::create has no donor+form+amount idempotency so a flaky gateway retry inserts two completed donations
fix: unique(idempotency_key) on donations and pass that key to the gateway
missing: the same donor form submit must complete once
reach: gateway retry after donor already sees a receipt
title: feat: donate

defect: Easy Digital Downloads edd_update_payment_status(complete) is not idempotent so two IPNs both deliver files and both capture
fix: UPDATE status SET complete WHERE status!=complete returning id; skip delivery if 0 rows
missing: a payment already complete must not complete or capture again
reach: PayPal IPN plus PDT both fire
title: feat: complete

defect: Craft Commerce Purchasable::getStock is read then setStock written so two carts oversell a limited variant
fix: atomic decrement WHERE stock>=qty; fail the line if rowcount=0
missing: stock decrement must be conditional on remaining stock
reach: two storefronts add the last limited variant
title: feat: adjust qty

defect: Reaction Commerce placeOrder copies the cart without locking so a retry inserts two orders and two captures
fix: unique(cartId) on Orders and a cart status transition to converted
missing: one cartId must place at most one order
title: feat: place order

defect: Swell cart complete has no client_id idempotency so a webhook replay creates a second paid order
fix: unique(cart_id) on orders and ignore duplicate completed events
missing: the same cart id must complete once
title: feat: complete

defect: Magento invoice capture() does not check captured flag so two admin clicks create two settlement batches
fix: UPDATE invoice SET captured=1 WHERE id=? AND captured=0; only then call the gateway
missing: an invoice already captured must be a no-op
title: feat: capture

defect: WooCommerce Subscriptions wcs_create_renewal_order has no unique(subscription, next_payment) so two crons charge the same period
fix: unique(subscription_id, billing_period_end) on renewal orders
missing: one subscription period must create one renewal order and one charge
title: feat: renew

defect: Saleor transactionProcess is not idempotent on pspReference so a webhook retry captures an already-captured transaction
fix: unique(psp_reference) and return the existing transaction action
missing: the same pspReference must process once
title: feat: process

defect: Camunda service task asyncAfter charges Stripe then the job executor retries after a JVM kill and Charge.create runs again
fix: external task with Stripe-Idempotency-Key = processInstanceId+activityId; store charge id in a variable first
missing: a charge service task must not create a second Stripe charge on job retry
title: feat: async

defect: Zeebe worker timeout is shorter than Stripe RTT so the broker redelivers and two workers both Charge.create
fix: Idempotency-Key = job.getKey() and fail the duplicate worker on a unique receipt row
missing: one job key must produce one charge
title: feat: job timeout

defect: Flowable async service task retries=3 after a successful Charge.create because the engine never saw the leave
fix: persist chargeId as a process variable in the same txn as the job complete; key = executionId
missing: retry of a charge delegate must not create a second charge
title: feat: job retry

defect: Activiti service task exclusive=false so two job executors run the same charge activity and both POST /v1/charges
fix: exclusive=true plus an Idempotency-Key on the activity instance id
missing: a charge activity must run exclusively
title: feat: exclusive

defect: jBPM timer cycle fires after the charge work item already completed so a leftover timer Charge.create again
fix: cancel the timer on complete and unique(processInstanceId, workItemId) on receipts
missing: a completed charge node must cancel its timer and never charge twice
title: feat: timer

defect: Bonita connector retries on a read timeout after HTTP 200 from Stripe so the leftover retry creates a second charge
fix: store charge id before complete; Stripe-Idempotency-Key = caseId+connectorId
missing: HTTP 200 plus a charge id must complete the connector without a second POST

defect: n8n webhook node has no unique execution key so Stripe retries the webhook and the Charge node runs twice
fix: unique(event.id) table checked before the Charge node; ignore duplicates
missing: one Stripe event id must execute the charge path once
title: feat: webhook

defect: Kestra task retry.warning=true reruns a Charge.create after the first attempt already returned 200
fix: retry only on 5xx; persist charge id in Kestra outputs and skip if set
missing: a successful charge task must not rerun Charge.create
title: feat: retry

defect: Windmill script retry after a worker kill reruns stripe.charges.create without an idempotency key
fix: Idempotency-Key = wm_job_id and unique(job_id) on receipts
missing: one job id must create one charge
title: feat: job

defect: NiFi ChargeProcessor onTrigger POSTs Stripe then yields so a processor restart replays the same FlowFile and charges twice
fix: write chargeId as an attribute after a unique FlowFile uuid receipt; skip POST if present
missing: a FlowFile already charged must transfer to success without a second POST
title: feat: onTrigger

defect: Apache Hop charge transform retries a row after the sink already POSTed Stripe
fix: Idempotency-Key = row.charge_id and a unique receipt before the HTTP call
missing: one input row id must charge once
title: feat: transform

defect: Airbyte reset-and-sync replays already-loaded invoice rows so the warehouse SUM(amount) doubles GMV
fix: incremental cursor plus unique(invoice_id) on the destination; reset must truncate first or skip existing ids
missing: a reset must not reload invoice ids already in the destination
title: feat: reset

defect: Mage.ai block retries after stripe.Charge.create because the block status write failed
fix: Idempotency-Key = pipeline_run_id+block_uuid and skip if receipt exists
missing: block retry must not create a second charge
title: feat: block

defect: Camunda external task lockDuration=0 so two workers fetch the same charge task and both POST Stripe
fix: lockDuration>=30s and Idempotency-Key = externalTaskId
missing: one external task id must be locked by one worker and charged once
title: feat: lock

defect: Zeebe publish message timeToLive=0 so a late correlate republishes and the charge catch event fires twice
fix: set a durable messageId and unique(messageId) on the catch; TTL long enough to debounce
missing: one message id must correlate once
title: feat: message

defect: Flowable timer cycle has no endDate so leftover repeats keep Charge.create after the subscription canceled
fix: endDate or cancel the timer job on cancel; guard the delegate on subscription.active
missing: a canceled subscription must not emit another charge timer
title: feat: timer

defect: n8n SplitInBatches acks the parent item before the charge sub-items finish so a crash drops remaining rows and a replay double-charges the first batch
fix: do not ack parent until all batch receipts exist; idempotency key per row id
missing: ack only after every sub-item charge commits
title: feat: batches

defect: Kestra ForEach retries the whole collection after one item Charge.create so earlier items charge again
fix: per-item receipt keyed by executionId+item.id before Charge.create
missing: already-charged items must be skipped on ForEach retry
title: feat: foreach

defect: Lago invoice regenerate clones line items without voiding the original so finance double-collects the same period

missing: regenerate must void or replace the prior invoice, not insert a second payable

defect: Chargebee cancel with credit_prorated plus a leftover cancel webhook both issue credits so the customer is paid twice
fix: unique(subscription_id, event_type=cancel) credit note and ignore the duplicate webhook
missing: one subscription cancel must issue one prorated credit
title: feat: cancel

defect: Recurly addon quantity is read-modify-write so two support agents both increment and the customer is billed 3 instead of 2
fix: PATCH with If-Match version or SQL qty=qty+1 WHERE subscription_id=?
missing: addon quantity must increment atomically
reach: two agents add the same addon
title: feat: addon qty

defect: Zuora amendment create has no lock on the subscription so two amendments both add the same charge and MRR doubles
fix: lock the subscription version and unique(subscriptionId, currentVersion)
missing: one subscription version must accept at most one in-flight amendment
reach: CPQ plus admin amend the same sub
title: feat: amend

defect: Kill Bill dry-run invoice is later persisted without a new target date so the leftover persist double-inserts invoice items
fix: unique(account_id, target_date, invoice_type) and a dry_run flag that cannot flip to committed
missing: a dry-run must not become a second payable invoice for the same target date
title: feat: dry-run

defect: Paddle subscription_payment_succeeded is applied after subscription_cancelled because handlers sort by receive time not event_time
fix: order by event_time and store last_event_time per subscription; ignore older events
missing: a cancelled subscription must not apply a later-received older payment_succeeded
title: feat: alert

defect: Lemon Squeezy custom_id is not unique so two checkouts with the same custom_id both mark the same entitlement paid twice
fix: unique(custom_id) on entitlements and reject the second order_created
missing: one custom_id must map to one order
title: feat: custom id

defect: FastSpring return URL creates the entitlement on GET so a refresh grants a second paid seat
fix: unique(order_id) entitlement and treat GET as a lookup, not a create
missing: return URL must be idempotent on order id
title: feat: return

defect: Maxio/Chargify component allocation is read then PUT so two agents both set allocated_quantity=1 and the meter bills 2
fix: POST allocations with idempotency key subscription+component+period
missing: allocation must be an atomic increment with a unique period
title: feat: allocate

defect: Mollie payments.create has no idempotencyKey so a client retry after 502 creates two paid payments for one order
fix: idempotencyKey=order_id and unique(order_id) on local payments
missing: one order must create one Mollie payment
title: feat: payment

defect: Razorpay order receipt is not unique so two create_order calls insert two orders and both capture
fix: receipt=merchant_order_id with unique constraint; reuse the existing razorpay_order_id
missing: receipt must be unique per merchant order
title: feat: order

defect: Mercado Pago preference create on every checkout render so a refresh makes two preferences and two IPNs both mark paid
fix: persist preference_id uniquely on the cart and reuse it on render
missing: one cart must have one preference
title: feat: preference

defect: Lago void invoice does not void the leftover credit note so finance applies a credit after the invoice is already void
fix: in the same txn set credit_note.status=void where invoice_id=?
missing: voiding an invoice must void or delete its open credit notes
title: feat: void

defect: Chargebee unbilled charge create retries after 504 and inserts two unbilled charges that both hit the next invoice
fix: unique(subscription_id, usage_date, description) or idempotency key on create
missing: one subscription usage event must create one unbilled charge
title: feat: unbilled

defect: Recurly mark_failed then a leftover mark_successful both apply so a failed invoice still collects
fix: state machine: failed cannot go to paid except via a new collection with unique(invoice_id, attempt)
missing: a failed invoice must not later collect as paid without a new attempt id
title: feat: mark paid

defect: Feast materialize incremental_begin omitted so a leftover run rewrites the online store with stale event_timestamp and fraud scores flip
fix: pass incremental_begin and upsert only if incoming event_timestamp >= stored
missing: materialize must not overwrite a newer event_timestamp with an older one
title: feat: materialize

defect: Tecton backfill has no ttl so leftover tiles overwrite live online features and the model scores yesterday as today
fix: set feature ttl and skip online write when event_time < now-ttl
missing: backfill tiles older than ttl must not write the online store

defect: Hopsworks feature group insert time_travel_format=OFF so a leftover insert overwrites primary-key rows and training GMV doubles
fix: enable time travel / append-only and unique(pk, event_time)
missing: primary-key rows must version not clobber
title: feat: feature group

defect: MLflow log_metric step is omitted so two workers overwrite the same (run, key) and the winning step is not the latest
fix: pass step=global_step and enable the unique metric constraint
missing: metrics must be unique on (run_id, key, step) and never clobber a higher step
title: feat: log metric

defect: ClearML Dataset.finalize then a leftover add_files on the same version overwrites blobs the training job already hashed
fix: refuse add_files after finalize; bump version for new files
missing: a finalized dataset version must be immutable
title: feat: dataset

defect: dvc checkout then the train script mutates the workspace file so the cache hash now points at a poisoned blob
fix: dvc checkout --copy or chmod a-w the cache object; never write in place
missing: checked-out cache objects must be immutable or copied

defect: Pachyderm pipeline retry reruns a datum that already POSTed a billed inference so the customer is charged twice
fix: Idempotency-Key = datum.ID and unique receipt before the billed call
missing: a datum already billed must not POST again on job retry
title: feat: pipeline

defect: Kedro catalog versioned=false so a leftover run overwrites the parquet the evaluator already opened and metrics flip
fix: versioned: true and pin the runner to a version
missing: published datasets must keep immutable versions
title: feat: catalog

defect: Metaflow foreach retry re-executes a billed task after the card was already charged
fix: Idempotency-Key = run_id/task_id and skip Charge.create if receipt exists
missing: one foreach task_id must charge once
title: feat: foreach

defect: Flyte task retries=3 after a side-effecting write so leftover retries append duplicate billed rows
fix: upsert on (execution_id, retry_group, entity_id) instead of insert
missing: task retry must not append a second billed row
title: feat: retry

defect: ZenML step cache key omits the artifact uri so a leftover cache hit serves yesterday's model and prices go stale
fix: enable materializer digest in the cache key; do not cache on step name alone
missing: cache keys must include the artifact digest
title: feat: cache

defect: TFX ExampleGen fingerprinting is off so a leftover span re-ingests the same GCS objects and Trainer counts rows twice
fix: enable input fingerprint and skip objects whose etag was already ingested
missing: the same object generation must not emit a second span
title: feat: examplegen

defect: Feast Push API online write omits event_timestamp so a late event overwrites a newer feature and fraud flips
fix: require event_timestamp and compare before SET
missing: online write must drop events older than the stored timestamp
title: feat: online write

defect: MLflow transition_model_version_stage has no If-Match so two CD jobs both promote and Staging points at two versions
fix: unique(name, stage) current pointer updated with a version check
missing: a stage must have one current version
title: feat: register

defect: Flyte dynamic task cache_ignore_input_vars includes the price table so leftover cache returns a billed plan from yesterday
fix: do not ignore price_table in cache_ignore_input_vars
missing: price inputs must be part of the cache key
title: feat: dynamic

defect: SurrealDB UPSERT user SET email without a unique index so two signups of the same email both succeed
fix: DEFINE INDEX uniq_email ON user COLUMNS email UNIQUE and catch the conflict
missing: email must be unique

defect: TerminusDB branch merge last-write-wins so a leftover merge drops a concurrent KYC document key

defect: JanusGraph email property has no uniqueness constraint so two vertices share an email and billing double-charges

missing: email must be a unique property

defect: HugeGraph secondary index is eventually consistent so a leftover read-after-write misses the user and signup inserts a second vertex
fix: unique index with wait on rebuild plus a compare-and-set insert
missing: unique email must be enforced on write, not on a delayed index read

defect: SurrealDB RELATE cart->order has no unique so two completes create two edges and two invoices
fix: DEFINE INDEX uniq_cart_order ON order COLUMNS cart UNIQUE
missing: one cart must relate to one order
title: feat: relate

defect: TerminusDB WOQL update reads a document then writes the whole object so a concurrent credit is lost

missing: update of one field must not clobber another
title: feat: woql

defect: ArcadeDB bucket RID reuse after compact so a leftover invoice pointer now charges a new order
fix: store a UUID property and a unique index; never persist #cluster:position across compact
missing: durable references must not be raw RIDs
title: feat: bucket

defect: QuestDB designated timestamp is server now() so a 2-day-late charge event lands in today and SUM doubles
fix: insert with the event designated timestamp and a watermark drop
missing: late charge events must keep their event time, not ingest time
title: feat: ingest

defect: VictoriaMetrics -dedup.minScrapeInterval=0 so leftover re-import of the same billed samples doubles the increase()
fix: set dedup.minScrapeInterval and unique samples on timestamp
missing: the same (metric, labels, timestamp) must store once
title: feat: import

defect: Warp 10 UPDATE of a GTS replaces all leftover points so a concurrent billed tick disappears and the invoice is short
fix: append ticks with unique class+labels+ts; do not UPDATE the whole GTS
missing: UPDATE must not drop points written by another producer
title: feat: update

defect: KairosDB downsample aggregator runs twice in the pipeline so billed SUM is doubled
fix: one aggregator stage and a unit test that SUM matches raw
missing: a metric must be downsampled once before billing
title: feat: aggregate

defect: OpenTSDB put of the same (ts, metric, tags) with different values sums on query so leftover retries double the bill
fix: enable last-write for identical keys or send an idempotent value
missing: duplicate timestamp must replace not sum

defect: M3DB aggregation namespace plus raw namespace are both billed so increase() is applied twice

defect: QuestDB DEDUP UPSERT KEYS omitted so leftover retries append duplicate charge rows and GMV doubles
fix: DEDUP UPSERT KEYS(id) on the designated timestamp table

defect: VictoriaMetrics relabel drop of refunds happens after count_over_time so leftover refunds still increment the invoice

title: feat: relabel

defect: Warp 10 ingress dedup is off so leftover retries write two ticks at the same ts and billed SUM doubles
fix: enable ingress dedup and unique(class, labels, ts)
missing: one (class, labels, ts) must store one tick

defect: Ceph RGW PUT omits If-Match so a leftover retry overwrites a newer invoice PDF another worker just wrote

defect: Garage website index.html PUT has no generation so a leftover deploy clobbers the billed price list with staging

defect: CubeFS inode reuse after delete so a leftover fd streams another tenant file

defect: LiveKit room empty timeout is 0 so a leftover reconnect creates a second room and double-bills the minute

defect: Janus VideoRoom publisher id is reused so a leftover subscriber is billed for a new publisher stream

defect: Jitsi Jigasi leaves a leftover conference session so SIP minutes keep billing after hangup

defect: Ion SFU subscribe has no unique(peer, track) so a leftover retry double-subscribes and double-bills downlink

defect: OpenSMTPD table persist is stale so leftover aliases still route refunds to a deleted billed mailbox
